title: Earthy Stir Fry
description: A simple stir fry recipe that combines earthy mushrooms with a variety of vegetables, cooked to perfection.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the earthy mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
